findings.evidence: Line 34 requires mechanical changes to be "in their own group, apart from behaviour changes", while line 38 requires "every changed file is in exactly one group". A file containing both mechanical and behavioral changes cannot satisfy both instructions, so the grouping validation loop has no compliant outcome.
findings.fix: Apply separate mechanical grouping to mechanical-only files. Assign mixed files once to their behavioral group and distinguish their mechanical hunks within that group; explicitly exempt those hunks from the separate-group requirement.

findings.evidence: "Before writing the report, compare the groups with `git diff --stat` (or the patch's file list)" offers an incorrect validation path for historical sources. Following the HEAD~3 example in a clean worktree produces a nonempty commit patch but an empty bare `git diff --stat`, which describes unstaged changes rather than the selected commit.
findings.fix: Make the selected patch's file list the default coverage manifest. If using --stat, preserve the selected commit, range or branch comparison and include separately collected untracked files; never substitute bare git diff --stat for a different selected source.
